implementation_notes: Reference screenshots are not literal copy or a source of exact CSS dimensions.

build_acceptance_criteria: Visual match to approved screenshot at desktop, adapted sensibly to mobile.
Every section exists in specified order and is semantically structured.
Text is live accessible HTML and buttons are functional.
All unverified reviews, results and fictional case imagery are replaced or omitted.
Every supplied reference-only crop is replaced with production-quality asset or rebuilt as HTML/CSS.
Pricing and inclusions agree with current commercial offer.
